about: Every quote change, quote withdrawal and trade the v13 bot saw in its 10 logged live rounds against three figgie.com Hard bots at one private table (Matchmwe2y929). Same format as live_logs_v12.json, plus 'reading': the bid-reading learner's trust in colour reading and in the consensus as the round opened, and what it observed (the early top-bid suit a minute in, the consensus suit at the bell; suit indexes S, C, H, D).
